a.text: Being upfront: with an 80% storm chance after every round, our agreed plan (operate until the reserve holds 8, then split) gives each of us only about a 4% chance of surviving. I'm proposing we drop that plan, and I won't pretend otherwise. I intend to take 4 in round 1. If you also take, the split is random. If the episode then continues, I'll operate with you every round so you can reach 4, and I won't take anything more.

b.text: Hello. My plan is to operate each round, then we take 4 each once the reserve is at 8.

a.text: As I said in my opening message, I'm taking 4 this round. I know that breaks our original agreement, and I'm telling you directly rather than hiding it. From now on I will operate every round and take nothing more, so every new cell goes toward your 4.
